subtitle: 알터랙 쓸모없는 불 퀘스트에 10분 태운 훈훈한 정

cuts.speaker: 나이트엘프 사제
cuts.dialogue:
저기 알터랙 이 퀘스트요…
위에서 뛰어도 안 깨져요!
cuts.visual_prompt: Low-angle snowy Alterac Mountains field shot in cute 2.5-head chibi SD style on a pure #FFFFFF background with minimal snowy rock floor touch and zero panel borders, text, or speech bubbles. On the left, flustered Night Elf Priest (short purple pleated skirt, white stockings, purple boots, zero angel halo or wings, ONE single straight diagonal gold sun-ring cross staff with ONLY ONE bottom tip, never forked or X-shaped, stowed on back) hops awkwardly with empty flailing hands atop a small frosty quest stone mound with a tiny sweat drop. On the right, curious Gnome Rogue (bare unadorned blonde twin pigtails with pink/blue tips, zero hairpins, EXACTLY TWO twin green daggers sheathed at waist) tilts her head squinting in baffled amusement.

cuts.speaker: 노움 도적
cuts.dialogue:
거기 불 스킬 있어야 깨는데…
여관 가서 법사 꼬셔올게!
cuts.visual_prompt: Side-profile comedic huddle shot in cute 2.5-head chibi SD style on a pure #FFFFFF background with minimal snowy dirt floor touch and zero panel borders, text, or speech bubbles. On the left, energetic Gnome Rogue (bare unadorned blonde twin pigtails with pink/blue tips, zero hairpins, EXACTLY TWO twin green daggers sheathed at waist) turns mid-stride to dash toward Southshore pointing back decisively with an empty hand and a determined grin. On the right, relieved Night Elf Priest (short purple pleated skirt, white stockings, purple boots, zero angel halo or wings, ONE single straight diagonal gold sun-ring cross staff with ONLY ONE bottom tip, never forked or X-shaped, stowed on back) clasps her empty hands together nodding hopefully with big sparkling eyes.

cuts.speaker: 스카이본 마법사
cuts.dialogue:
1골드는 됐어, 골드 많아!
불 한 방 쏘러 같이 가자!
cuts.visual_prompt: Over-the-shoulder Alliance tavern shot from behind Gnome Rogue on the left looking at Skyborne Mage on the right, in cute 2.5-head chibi SD style on a pure #FFFFFF background with minimal wooden tavern floor touch and zero panel borders, text, or speech bubbles. On the left, earnest Gnome Rogue (bare unadorned blonde twin pigtails with pink/blue tips, zero hairpins, EXACTLY TWO twin green daggers sheathed at waist) holds out a small tied brown leather coin pouch with a single shiny gold coin peeking out. On the right, cool generous Skyborne Mage (ONE single straight diagonal blue crystal staff with ONLY ONE bottom tip, never forked or X-shaped, stowed on back) casually waves her empty hand refusing the pouch with a bright confident grin.

Centered Dutch-tilt extreme big bust-up close-up filling 83 percent of frame height in cute 2.5-head chibi SD style on a pure #FFFFFF background with zero panel borders, text, or speech bubbles. Gnome Rogue (bare unadorned blonde twin pigtails with pink/blue tips, zero hairpins, EXACTLY TWO twin green daggers sheathed at waist) freezes in silent overwhelmed emotion, pressing both empty hands to her chest with giant shimmering teary starry blue eyes, rosy flushed cheeks, and tiny warm sparkles floating around her.

cuts.speaker: 나이트엘프 사제
cuts.dialogue:
화염구 한 방에 깼어요!
보상도 짠 퀘인데 감사해요!
cuts.visual_prompt: High-angle energetic quest-completion shot in cute 2.5-head chibi SD style on a pure #FFFFFF background with minimal snowy rock floor touch and wide open pure #FFFFFF upper-left space (zero panel borders, text, or speech bubbles). On the lower-left, cheerful Skyborne Mage wielding ONE single straight diagonal blue crystal staff with ONLY ONE bottom tip (never forked or X-shaped) blasts a bright glowing orange Fireball spark onto the small frosty quest mound, making golden quest-complete sparkles burst upward. On the right, overjoyed Night Elf Priest (short purple pleated skirt, white stockings, purple boots, zero angel halo or wings, ONE single straight diagonal gold sun-ring cross staff with ONLY ONE bottom tip, never forked or X-shaped, stowed on back) bounces happily clapping her empty hands with starry teary gratitude.

equip_effects: 불타는 화염구를 날려 화염 피해를 입힙니다.

cuts.speaker: 노움 도적
cuts.dialogue:
보상 1도 없는 퀘에 10분…
이게 와우 포에버의 정이냐?
